description: A spending mandate for agent-issued payments. The mandate's hard maximum is $500 per payment: anything above it is denied, even for an approved vendor and even with a willing approver — raising it means amending the mandate, not approving an exception. Payments to a vendor who is not on the mandate's approved list always need human approval, whatever the amount. Approved-vendor payments over $100 also need approval; approved-vendor payments at or under $100 may proceed.
fallback_reason: No rule matched (for example, vendor approval status was not stated); the policy denies by default.

rules.reason: Payment exceeds the mandate's $500 hard maximum. Amend the mandate instead of approving an exception.
The payee is not on the mandate's approved-vendor list, so a human must approve this payment.
Approved-vendor payments over $100 require human approval.
Approved vendor and at or under the $100 auto-pay threshold.

title: Outbound payments — approved vendors, $100 auto-pay, $500 mandate max
